name: @game-hub/game-stoneage
description: Stone Age as a single in-workspace game package — the Track D legacy-migration (phase 3) retrofit. Four subpath exports over TypeScript source: ./engine (pure worker-placement rules core), ./module (backend GameModule with the gather-roll route + bot runner), ./client (UI GameClient — illustrated zoomable board), ./bot (AI placement model + self-play + bench). Depends only on @game-hub/kernel (+ React for ./client, Fastify types for ./module).
